source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The preference slice transforms values for Redux while its set effect writes the raw action payload using the existing preference type. External pref changes dispatch sync; reset clears the user value. Extra reducers do not automatically gain persistence effects. The integration task checks that baz changes Redux without changing the raw pref, and distinguishes a BAR pref-change wait from the lower-case Redux result. A fallback does not create a typed preference; the effect has an explicit invalid-type branch.
title: Preference slices keep transformed Redux values separate from raw typed preference writes
